flows:
Navigate to https://linear.app/ then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
At 320 CSS pixels, use vertical scrolling to read the public feature overview headings.
Verify the feature overview is readable without horizontal scrolling.
Do not open signup.

remark: analyze: The final result is on the page.
assert: The final result is on the page.
